lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa and George are going to the playgroup. It's George's first day.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治要去幼儿园。这是乔治第一天去。

lines.en: George, are you looking forward to the playgroup?
lines.zh: 乔治，你期待去幼儿园吗？

lines.en: Daddy, maybe George is too small to go to my playgroup!
lines.zh: 爸爸，也许乔治太小了，不能去我的幼儿园！

lines.en: He'll be fine, Peppa.
lines.zh: 他会没事的，佩奇。

lines.en: There'll be you and Mr. Dinosaur there to keep him company.
lines.zh: 有你和恐龙先生在那儿陪着他呢。

lines.en: But I want to play with the big children, not George and his toy dinosaur.
lines.zh: 可我想和大孩子们一起玩，不是乔治和他的玩具恐龙。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Peppa doesn't want George to go to her playgroup.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。佩奇不想让乔治去她的幼儿园。

lines.en: We're here.
lines.zh: 我们到了。

lines.en: Daddy, are you sure George is big enough?
lines.zh: 爸爸，你确定乔治够大了吗？

lines.en: He'll be fine. All right, he can come.
lines.zh: 他会没事的。好吧，他可以进去。

lines.en: Bye-bye!
lines.zh: 再见！

lines.en: Madam Gazelle looks after the children at the playgroup.
lines.zh: 羚羊夫人在幼儿园照顾孩子们。

lines.en: Hello! This is my little brother, George.
lines.zh: 你们好！这是我的弟弟，乔治。

lines.en: Hello, George!
lines.zh: 你好，乔治！

lines.en: I wish I had a little brother like George. Really?
lines.zh: 我真希望我也有一个像乔治这样的弟弟。真的吗？

lines.en: Hello. I'm Danny Dog. Is that a dinosaur?
lines.zh: 你好。我是小狗丹尼。那是一只恐龙吗？

lines.en: It's just a toy dinosaur.
lines.zh: 那只是一只玩具恐龙。

lines.en: Grr! Dinosaur.
lines.zh: 吼！恐龙。

lines.en: Brilliant!
lines.zh: 太棒了！

lines.en: Aah! Really scary! That's brilliant!
lines.zh: 啊！真吓人！太棒了！

lines.en: George is my brother. He's brilliant.
lines.zh: 乔治是我的弟弟。他很棒。

lines.en: Peppa is proud of her little brother George.
lines.zh: 佩奇为她的弟弟乔治感到骄傲。

lines.en: Shall we show George how we paint pictures?
lines.zh: 我们教乔治怎么画画好吗？

lines.en: George is not very good at painting.
lines.zh: 乔治不太会画画。

lines.en: Well, maybe you could help him. Yes! I'm very good!
lines.zh: 嗯，也许你可以帮帮他。好！我画得可好了！

lines.en: I will show him how to paint a flower.
lines.zh: 我来教他怎么画一朵花。

lines.en: George, today I'm going to teach you how to paint a flower.
lines.zh: 乔治，今天我要教你画一朵花。

lines.en: First you paint a big circle.
lines.zh: 首先你画一个大圆圈。

lines.en: No, George, that's the wrong color.
lines.zh: 不对，乔治，颜色用错了。

lines.en: Now you paint the flower's petals.
lines.zh: 现在你画花瓣。

lines.en: George! That's the wrong shape.
lines.zh: 乔治！形状不对。

lines.en: Now you paint the stalk and the leaves.
lines.zh: 现在你画花茎和叶子。

lines.en: Perfect!
lines.zh: 完美！

lines.en: George! You have done it all wrong!
lines.zh: 乔治！你全画错了！

lines.en: Now, what do we have here? I've painted a flower!
lines.zh: 来看看，我们这儿有什么？我画了一朵花！

lines.en: That's very good, Peppa.
lines.zh: 画得非常好，佩奇。

lines.en: And George has painted a dinosaur!
lines.zh: 而乔治画了一只恐龙！

lines.en: I think George and Peppa's pictures should go on the wall.
lines.zh: 我觉得乔治和佩奇的画应该贴到墙上去。

lines.en: Hooray!
lines.zh: 太好啦！

lines.en: Peppa, you must be very proud of your little brother.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你一定为你的弟弟感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: Yes, I am!
lines.zh: 是的，我很骄傲！

lines.en: It is home time, and the children's parents are here to pick them up.
lines.zh: 放学时间到了，孩子们的父母来接他们了。

lines.en: Can George come next time?
lines.zh: 乔治下次还能来吗？

lines.en: Yes. And he can paint us another lovely picture.
lines.zh: 可以。他还能再给我们画一幅漂亮的画。

lines.en: And what will you paint next time, George?
lines.zh: 那你下次要画什么，乔治？

lines.en: Dinosaur! Grr!
lines.zh: 恐龙！吼！

lines.en: Oh, another dinosaur picture?
lines.zh: 哦，又是一幅恐龙画？

lines.en: Well, maybe you can show us all how to paint a dinosaur!
lines.zh: 嗯，也许你可以教教大家怎么画恐龙！

lines.en: Yes! Brilliant!
lines.zh: 好！太棒了！
